MARIADB_ROOT_PASSWORD.description: Generated mariadb root password. Keep private and preserve with backups.

MARIADB_ROOT_HOST.description: Mariadb root host for mariadb. The supplied value follows the pinned upstream deployment; change only with its configuration guide.

REDIS_PASSWORD.description: Generated private Redis/Valkey password, or a reference to that password. Keep secret.

REDIS_URL.description: Private authenticated Redis/Valkey connection URL. Automatically assembled from service references.

PORT.description: HTTP port inside this service. Keep the default to match its Railway public port and health check.

FRAPPE_APP.description: Frappe app for frappe-learning. The supplied value follows the pinned upstream deployment; change only with its configuration guide.

TEMPLATE_RELEASE.description: Template release for frappe-learning. The supplied value follows the pinned upstream deployment; change only with its configuration guide.

FRAPPE_SITE_NAME.description: Frappe site name for frappe-learning. The supplied value follows the pinned upstream deployment; change only with its configuration guide.

PUBLIC_URL.description: Public url resolved automatically from the linked service. Keep this reference when using the included topology.

DB_HOST.description: Db host resolved automatically from the linked service. Keep this reference when using the included topology.

DB_PORT.description: Db port for frappe-learning. The supplied value follows the pinned upstream deployment; change only with its configuration guide.

DB_ROOT_PASSWORD.description: Db root password resolved automatically from the linked service. Keep this reference when using the included topology.

ADMIN_PASSWORD.description: Generated admin password. Keep private and preserve with backups.

REDIS_URL.description: Private authenticated Redis/Valkey connection URL. Automatically assembled from service references.

WEB_WORKERS.description: Web workers for frappe-learning. The supplied value follows the pinned upstream deployment; change only with its configuration guide.

ALLOW_MIGRATION.description: For an existing site, back up its database and files before allowing migration to a changed release.

RAILWAY_DOCKERFILE_PATH.description: Repository-relative Dockerfile used to build this service. Keep the supplied path.
